_about: Crash modification factors (CMF) for the proactive score. S = 100 x product(1 / CMF). CMF = 1.0 is the safe reference. Starting values chosen within the ranges of the HSM / CMF Clearinghouse / iRAP literature for rural roads and rounded; they are NOT calibrated on Bulgarian data. Bands: the first [upper_bound, cmf] whose bound is greater than the value applies, otherwise 'else'. For 'lower_is_worse' elements the small values carry the big CMFs (documentation only, same rule).

overtaking._rule: single carriageway, <= 2 lanes, speed limit >= 80, no overtaking lane

vulnerable_users._rule: undivided roads only: 1 + w x settlement_share x (sidewalk ? factor : 1) + min(cap, per_crossing x crossings_per_km)

markings._rule: no public data on sign and marking condition; neutral until field data exists

speed_undivided._rule: project addition: speed limit >= 90 km/h on an undivided road
